items.title: VA-Spec 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09 migration — Design
items.text: Status: design (drafting 2026-09-29). Branch feat/va-spec-1.1.0-ballot-2026-09. Migrates clinvar-gkm from va-spec 1.1.0-ballot.2026-07.2 (current submodule) to the 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09 branch (commit 81d48e1 as of 2026-09-29), the next official VA-Spec release. NB: track the branch, not the tag 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.1 — the tag is ~10 commits behind (no DataItem; EvidenceLine not yet re-instated as a distinct class). The branch's schema $id version label is still 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.1. Goal: emit output that validates against the 2026-09 va-spec JSON schemas. This spec partially reverses the 2026-08-12-custompropositions-conformance-and-delivery-grouping design — the CustomProposition mechanism it targeted is deleted upstream.

items.title: Decisions locked (2026-09-29)
items.text:
1. Community-profile scope = Statement types only. Adopt the profile Statement classes (VariantPathogenicityStatement for germline, VariantClinicalSignificanceStatement for AAC/somatic) so classification+strength validate under the profiles; do not synthesize per-criterion EvidenceLines (ClinVar does not reliably carry ACMG PVS1/PS/… or AMP-tier criterion codes). → Phase 2.
  2. Custom ClinVar*Propositions = bespoke subtypes of the open base. Emit the real type name (type:"ClinvarAffectsProposition", …); redefine each schema/clinvar-gkm/json/Clinvar*Proposition as a subtype of the now-open, abstract va-spec:SubjectVariantProposition, and validate against it.
  3. Qualifiers = typed fields. Use the same typed qualifier fields as the standard propositions (geneContextQualifier, alleleOriginQualifier, modeOfInheritanceQualifier, penetranceQualifier) on the custom subtypes — retire the generic qualifiers[] {name,value} array.
  4. Rollout = phased, oracle-gated PRs. Phase 1 (core conformance) lands and is oracle-verified (0,0,0) before Phase 2 (profile adoption).

items.title: Success criteria
items.text:
• submodules/va-spec at 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.1; all schema/ symlinks + $id/$ref resolve.
  • A representative sample of emitted propositions, statements, and evidence lines validates against the 2026-09 schema/va-spec/json/* and schema/clinvar-gkm/json/* (statements/ELs are currently unvalidated — see §5).
  • Reconstruction oracle = 0,0,0 on all sections after accounting for the intended, one-time value churn (every proposition's JSON changes due to the field renames — expected, not a regression).

items.title: 0. Upstream change summary (what the 2026-09 ballot does)
items.text:
Verified by git -C submodules/va-spec diff 1.1.0-ballot.2026-07.2 origin/1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.

Cross-cutting - Schema tree flattened: schema/va-spec/base/json/<Class> → schema/va-spec/json/<Class> (the base/ layer is gone). Community profiles moved to schema/va-spec/json/{acmg-2015,aac-2017,ccv-2022}/. - Core dep renamed + bumped: gks-core/1.2.0-ballot.2026-07.1 → gkm-core/1.3.0-ballot.2026-09.1; VRS 2.1.0… → 2.1.1-ballot.2026-09.1; Cat-VRS 1.1.0… → 1.1.1-ballot.2026-09.1. - $id prefix drops /base/; test namespace va-spec.base → va-spec. - Build toolchain renamed + bumped: the schemas are generated by the GA4GH metaschema processor, now ga4gh.gkm.metaschema==0.4.8 (was ga4gh.gks.metaschema==0.3.2; repo ga4gh/gkm-metaschema). Same CLI (source2classes/source2splitjs/y2t), but the source-YAML DSL changed — the new va-spec sources declare base classes with inherits:+abstract: and compose profiles via inline allOf:[$refCurie: base, {properties: …}] (no protectedClassOf/…Properties $defs). clinvar-gkm's four *-source.yaml files + .requirements.txt + y2md.py import must track this.

Propositions - CustomProposition is deleted (class + schema + fixture). New pattern: give the object its own type name and validate against the now-open, abstract Proposition / SubjectVariantProposition (no additionalProperties:false on those bases → extra typed fields tolerated). - All proposition subject/object slots unified: subjectVariant→subject; and objectCondition/objectTumorType/objectTherapy all collapse to a single object (Condition|ConditionSet|iriReference for condition/tumor semantics). Qualifier fields keep their typed names. VariantTherapeuticResponseProposition now requires conditionQualifier.

Statements & EvidenceLines (both closed leaves — additionalProperties:false) - New abstract root InformationEntity → {Statement, EvidenceLine, StudyResult, DataItem}. - EvidenceLine.hasEvidenceItems widened to InformationEntity|iriReference — it now carries both standard evidence (Statement/StudyResult/DataItem) and nested EvidenceLines. Target link is targetProposition (Proposition|iri). - Statement: adds hasEvidence (Statement/StudyResult/DataItem — excludes EvidenceLine) for raw cited evidence; keeps hasEvidenceLines (EvidenceLine|iri) for scored arguments; adds quality, score; direction no longer required (required: [proposition, type]).

Community profiles (Phase 2): acmg-2015 = VariantPathogenicityStatement/…EvidenceLine; aac-2017 = VariantClinicalSignificanceStatement, AmpAscoCapEvidenceLine (+Diagnostic/Prognostic/ Therapeutic); ccv-2022 = oncogenicity. Strict methodType↔code coupling; "not-met ⇒ neutral, no strength" rule. Profile Statement enums are guideline-specific (strength/classification vocab + system const + specifiedBy required).

items.title: 1. Cross-cutting mechanical migration
items.text:
1.1 Submodule bump. submodules/va-spec → 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.1, including nested cat-vrs/vrs/gkm-core. Confirm the schema/ symlinks (schema/va-spec, schema/cat-vrs, schema/vrs) still resolve; add schema/gkm-core and retire schema/gks-core (the symlink name + any references).

1.2 clinvar-gkm schema source refs. Every $ref/import in schema/clinvar-gkm/*.yaml (and the generated json/*) points at .../va-spec/1.1.0-ballot.2026-07.2/base/json/..., .../gks-core/1.2.0-ballot.2026-07.1/..., vrs/2.1.0…, cat-vrs/1.1.0…. Update to: va-spec/1.1.0-ballot.2026-09.1/json/..., gkm-core/1.3.0-ballot.2026-09.1/..., vrs/2.1.1…, cat-vrs/1.1.1… (note /base/ removed). Then cd schema/clinvar-gkm && make to regenerate; commit only the semantic diff (metaschema emits $defs in set order — canonical-diff to filter reorder churn; ref ga4gh/gks-metaschema#63).

1.3 clinvar-gkm schema version bump (decision). The $id version is 1.0-rc3. This release is consumer-breaking (field renames) → bump to 1.0-rc4 (or 1.0.0). Open — confirm target version.

1.4 Validator path-routing fix (src/scripts/validate-schema-conformance.py). Two fragile assumptions break under the reorg: (a) schema discovery only descends dirs literally named json (load_registry, ~L76) — the flattened + per-profile layout is still under json/ dirs, OK, but verify; (b) routing is by bare filename, first-wins (name2contents.setdefault, ~L93 / schema_name_for ~L98-105) — with profiles, same-named classes can now exist across json/ and profile dirs and silently shadow. Make routing path-aware (namespace-qualified) and drop the customPropositionType route (§2). relax_additional_properties (~L40-61) still needed for closed-world allOf.

items.title: 2. Propositions — rename + custom recreation (the priority)
items.text:
2.1 Uniform rename (all proposition types, all 3 levels). subjectVariant → subject; objectCondition/objectTumorType/objectTherapy → object. This removes the object-field divergence the prior spec (§3.5) had to special-case — Oncogenicity and TherapeuticResponse targets now just use object. Keep typed qualifier fields as-is.

2.2 Drop the CustomProposition shape. Stop emitting type:"CustomProposition" + customPropositionType. Emit the real type (ClinvarAffectsProposition, ClinvarRiskFactorProposition, … all 10 incl. ClinvarUndefinedProposition) directly. Predicate map is unchanged (the CASE at gkm-vcv-statement-proc.sql ~L516-530, duplicated ~L554-568 / ~L592-606; SCV ~L204-214). Retire the generic qualifiers[] array; emit typed geneContextQualifier/modeOfInheritanceQualifier/ penetranceQualifier (SCV only, only when present) matching the standard shape.

2.3 Schema rework (schema/clinvar-gkm/clinvar-proposition-source.yaml): - ClinvarGermlineCustomProposition: re-base allOf from deleted va-spec:CustomProposition → va-spec:SubjectVariantProposition (open). Replace the generic qualifiers[] $def with the typed qualifier fields; subject/object now inherited from the open base (verify the narrowing: object = Condition|ConditionSet|iri). - Each Clinvar*Proposition: keep the type const = its own name (drop customPropositionType), keep the predicate const. ClinvarProposition union oneOf refs update to the new va-spec json/ paths. - These remain open subtypes (no additionalProperties:false), which is what makes them valid against the open base while carrying ClinVar-specific typed qualifiers.

2.4 VCV object cardinality (carry-over from prior spec §3.5 #1 — still required). VCV emits agg.unique_conditions (an array) as the object across all 3 layers; the schema wants a single Condition|ConditionSet|iri. Fix: emit a single ConditionSet pointer when >1 member, a bare Condition when exactly 1 (mirroring RCV/SCV). Reconcile parquet-schemas/vcv_proposition-side and the rcv_proposition.sql JSON_VALUE_ARRAY extractor to single.

2.5 conditionQualifier now required on TherapeuticResponse. The somatic target props already emit objectTherapy+conditionQualifier per the prior spec; after the object*→object rename, verify conditionQualifier is present on every VariantTherapeuticResponseProposition (now in required), or validation fails.

2.6 Pipeline emission — three procs (gkm-scv-statement-proc.sql ~L546-572 subject-prop shape / ~L204-214 type; gkm-vcv-statement-proc.sql ~L508-534 ×3 layers; gkm-rcv-statement-proc.sql analogous). Keep the wide-struct + JSON_STRIP_NULLS(remove_empty=>TRUE) idiom; the is_custom branch now only toggles open-vs-closed qualifier handling, not the field names (subject/object are uniform).

2.7 Downstream coordination. parquet-schemas/{varcond,vartumor,vartherapy,varcustom}-proposition.sql + the group split in export-gkm-dicts.sh (~L94-105, ~L198-201): read type/subject/object (drop customPropositionType/subjectVariant/objectCondition). Bundle SECTIONS names (assemble-gkm-dicts.py ~L68-87) unchanged. Delta: full one-time churn of every proposition record (intended).

items.title: 3. EvidenceLines — restructure
items.text:
3.1 Aggregate ELs: evidenceItems → hasEvidenceItems. VCV/RCV aggregate evidence lines (gkm-vcv-statement-proc.sql ~L415-497; gkm-rcv-statement-proc.sql ~L462-540) hold an array of lower-layer Statement pointers under evidenceItems. Statements are InformationEntity, so those refs are valid items — this is a straight property rename to hasEvidenceItems. Update parquet-schemas/{vcv,rcv}_evidenceLine.sql (evidenceItems column) + the evidenceLine bundle merge (assemble-gkm-dicts.py ~L83). No EL-under-EL nesting exists today and none is introduced in Phase 1; the current chain (Statement → hasEvidenceLines → EL → hasEvidenceItems → lower Statements) maps cleanly onto the 2026-09 model.

3.2 Somatic EL: proposition → targetProposition. The SCV somatic EL (gkm-scv-statement-proc.sql ~L864-942) emits a bespoke proposition field; va-spec EvidenceLine's property is targetProposition (Proposition|iri). Rename in the proc + parquet-schemas/ evidenceLine.sql (proposition_id). Rewrite the bespoke schema/clinvar-gkm/json/ClinvarSomaticEvidenceLine to simply narrow the native targetProposition to the 3 somatic types (+iri) — its current extra proposition/evidenceOutcome $def is redundant (both are native to va-spec EvidenceLine now) and, on a closed leaf, non-conformant.

items.title: 4. Statement conformance
items.text:
• va-spec Statement/EvidenceLine are closed leaves. The bespoke Clinvar{Scv,Vcv,Rcv}Statement schemas may only narrow (no added top-level properties beyond what va-spec defines) — audit and remove any added fields, or move them to extensions.
  • direction optional now: no emission change needed, but any downstream code assuming direction is always present must null-check.
  • clinvar-gkm continues to use Statement.hasEvidenceLines (not the new Statement.hasEvidence) — no change; hasEvidence is available if we later want to cite raw evidence without an EL wrapper.

items.title: 5. Validation + oracle gate (Phase 1 exit)
items.text:
• Extend validate-schema-conformance.py to also validate Statements and EvidenceLines (currently skipped) against the 2026-09 schemas — this is the gate that catches the renames and stray fields.
  • Structural checks in validate-proposition-conformance.sh: drop the CustomProposition↔ customPropositionType assertions; add "type ∈ known Clinvar*/Variant* set", "single object", "subject/object present".
  • Reconstruction oracle (oracle-delta-reconstruction.sh) must be 0,0,0 on all sections after the intended value churn is accounted for (diff shows only renamed fields + reshaped custom props).

items.title: Phase 2 — Community profile Statement types (acmg-2015, aac-2017)
items.text:
Scope (locked): Statement types only, applied selectively. Tag a statement with a profile Statement type only when the SCV's assertion method indicates the guideline was used — do not blanket-apply (profile Statement schemas assert guideline conformance: guideline-specific strength/classification vocab, a system const, and specifiedBy required).

  • Germline VariantPathogenicityProposition statements → VariantPathogenicityStatement (acmg-2015) where assertion method = ACMG 2015. Requires: classification ∈ {pathogenic, likely pathogenic, benign, likely benign, uncertain significance} (+ ClinGen low-penetrance/risk-allele set); strength ∈ {definitive, likely} with system const "ACMG Guidelines, 2015"; classification+specifiedBy required.
  • Somatic VariantClinicalSignificanceProposition statements → VariantClinicalSignificanceStatement (aac-2017) where assertion method = AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017. Requires: classification ∈ {tier i…iv}, strength ∈ {strong, potential}, tier→direction rules (Tier III neutral, Tier IV disputes, no strength).

items.title: Phase 2 open questions (resolve when Phase 2 is planned in detail)
items.text:
1. Qualifying signal — which AssertionMethod values (currently free text in specifiedBy.name) map to ACMG-2015 / AMP-ASCO-CAP-2017? Need an authoritative mapping (upstream or a curated list).
  2. Coding conformance — clinvar-gkm's classification/strength primaryCoding come from upstream clinvar_clinsig_types; the profile enums + system consts must match exactly or validation fails. Determine whether to remap codings or gate profile-typing on already-conformant codings.
  3. hasEvidenceLines restriction — profile Statements restrict hasEvidenceLines to the profile EL type (or iri). Our aggregate ELs are referenced by iri, which satisfies the schema branch — confirm.
  4. Delivery — do profile-typed statements change the scv/vcv/rcv bundle sections or add a discriminator column? Coordinate with the delta model.

(Profile per-criterion EvidenceLines — VariantPathogenicityEvidenceLine, AmpAscoCapEvidenceLine — are explicitly out of scope: ClinVar lacks the structured criterion codes. Revisit only if upstream supplies them.)

items.title: Full change surface
items.text:
• Submodule/symlinks: submodules/va-spec bump; schema/gkm-core symlink (retire gks-core).
  • Build toolchain: .requirements.txt (ga4gh.gks.metaschema==0.3.2→ga4gh.gkm.metaschema==0.4.8), schema/clinvar-gkm/y2md.py import; the four *-source.yaml files migrated to the 0.4.8 DSL idiom (protectedClassOf→inline allOf:[base,{properties}]).
  • Schema: schema/clinvar-gkm/*.yaml (proposition + statement sources — ref bumps, object*→object, custom re-base to open SubjectVariantProposition, typed qualifiers, ClinvarSomaticEvidenceLine narrows targetProposition); regenerate json/ + class docs; version bump (§1.3).
  • Procs: gkm-{scv,vcv,rcv}-statement-proc.sql (renames, custom reshape, VCV object single, evidenceItems→hasEvidenceItems, somatic proposition→targetProposition).
  • Export/Parquet: export-gkm-dicts.sh, parquet-schemas/{*-proposition,scv,vcv,rcv,evidenceLine, vcv_evidenceLine,rcv_evidenceLine}.sql.
  • Bundle: assemble-gkm-dicts.py (section list unchanged; verify pointer prefixes).
  • Validation: validate-schema-conformance.py (path-aware routing + validate Statements/ELs), validate-proposition-conformance.sh (assertions updated).
  • Docs: proposition/statement/evidence-line class + pipeline pages; propositions predicate table (also fix the hasClinicalSignificanceFor vs docs isClinicallySignificantFor drift).
  • ADR: add docs/decisions/0004-va-spec-2026-09-migration.md capturing the four locked decisions.

items.title: Rollout (phased, oracle-gated)
items.text:
• PR 1 (Phase 1a): submodule bump + symlink/ref/path updates + schema regen + validator path fix. Gate: schemas resolve, existing validation still green.
  • PR 2 (Phase 1b/c): proposition rename+custom recreation, VCV object single, EvidenceLine renames, Statement audit; validator extended to Statements/ELs. Gate: sample validates 0 failures; reconstruction oracle 0,0,0 (intended churn accounted). (1b and 1c may split further if review surface is large.)
  • PR 3+ (Phase 2): profile Statement typing, after Phase-2 questions resolved. Each PR oracle-gated.

items.title: Risks / watch-items
items.text:
• Metaschema processor upgrade is a hard dependency: the schema build requires ga4gh.gkm.metaschema==0.4.8 and its changed source-YAML DSL. The exact set of DSL edits to the clinvar *-source.yaml files (chiefly protectedClassOf→inline allOf:[base,{properties}]) can only be confirmed by running make under 0.4.8 — the first clean build is the schema checkpoint.
  • One-time full delta churn on every proposition (field renames) — expected; make it explicit in the release notes so consumers aren't surprised.
  • Closed-leaf allOf composition for bespoke Statement/EL types can be unsatisfiable under strict validators; the validator's relax_additional_properties handles it, but genuine extra fields must go to extensions.
  • gks-metaschema non-deterministic $defs ordering — canonical-diff on regen (ga4gh/gks-metaschema#63).
  • Consumer breakage — gks-core→gkm-core, /base/ path removal, and subjectVariant/objectCondition → subject/object all change the published contract; coordinate the announcement with the release.
